mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, password, role FROM clinic_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, appointment_id, file_name, stored_name, content_type, file_size, file_path FROM clinic_attachment WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clinic_attachment (appointment_id, file_name, stored_name, content_type, file_size, file_path) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath})
INSERT INTO clinic_notice (patient_id, channel, title, content, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{channel}, #{title}, #{content}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: MERGE INTO clinic_config (config_key, config_value, description) KEY (config_key) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description})
